heading: Features
paragraphs: The development team can categorize and prioritize issues based on their severity, impact on users, and importance to the project.
The issue tracker facilitates communication between customers and the development team.
The issue tracker maintains a record of each issue's status, including whether it's open, in progress, resolved, or closed.
